svg.text: OPEN WATER
THE NARROWS
MAP REWORK · MOCKUP A
Windward Ring
Ports sit around the rim, one on each side of the
wind. The middle is a field of ridges and reefs:
thread it for a short, tricky crossing, or sail
round the outside in open water.
SAMPLE TRADE LEGS (SLOOP, STEADY WIND)
Timber run · Calda → Saltmere
382 units · ≈ 31 s · downwind, outside the reefs
Stone haul · Stonehaven → Calda
593 units · ≈ 76 s · upwind through the Narrows
Grain · Westholm → Stonehaven
362 units · ≈ 28 s · reach
Fish ⇄ grain · Westholm ⇄ Saltmere
548 units · ≈ 42 s · beam reach both ways
WHAT CHANGES
• Ports pushed out to radius ~300; legs ~25 s to 1.5 min
• Ports are the biggest islands; scenery is smaller
• Ridges have B2 cliffs and beaches, not flat slabs
• Reef fields with shallows glow make lanes readable
• Outer islands become locked future ports
• Open water kept on the east rim for fast ships
KEY
Trading port (pier, town, what it makes)
Locked island: future port, unlocked later
Reef: rocks and coral, solid to the hull
Shallows glow · darker blue = deep channel
Static mockup, not game geometry. Times use the real sloop polar.
